---

### 📰 Top Sources for Stock Market News

1. **CNBC** – [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com)
   CNBC reports that stocks have closed at record highs with tech leading the way, and the Nasdaq has gained 8% in May.

2. **Yahoo Finance** – [finance.yahoo.com](https://finance.yahoo.com)
   Yahoo Finance highlights that the May nonfarm payrolls report and Broadcom earnings will be in focus for investors this week. It's a great all-in-one platform for quotes, news, and analysis.

3. **CNN Markets** – [cnn.com/markets](https://www.cnn.com/markets)
   CNN provides up-to-date stock market data coverage, including the latest updates on US markets, world markets, stock quotes, crypto, commodities, and currencies.

4. **Nasdaq** – [nasdaq.com](https://www.nasdaq.com)
   Nasdaq.com offers the latest stock market news, stock information & quotes, data analysis reports, as well as a general overview of the market landscape.

5. **Morningstar** – [morningstar.com/markets](https://www.morningstar.com/markets)
   Morningstar provides in-depth market analysis and investment insights. They recently noted that growth categories like technology and AI stocks are no longer providing an excess margin of safety, and offer tips on how to distinguish between signal and noise when investing in stocks.

6. **Edward Jones – Daily Market Recap** – [edwardjones.com](https://www.edwardjones.com/us-en/market-news-insights/stock-market-news/daily-market-recap)
   Edward Jones helps you stay up to date with the latest developments, trends, and daily insights on the market, offering a comprehensive look at market movements, international updates, economic indicators, and expert analysis.

7. **NYSE** – [nyse.com](https://www.nyse.com)
   According to the NYSE, the S&P 500 ended up over 1% for the week, hitting yet another record high and closing in on the next whole number milestone at 7600.

---

### 📈 What's Happening in the Market Right Now?

- Stocks are adding to gains on Middle East ceasefire optimism, with major equity indexes slightly higher and posting their ninth consecutive weekly gain.
- AI-driven demand continues to support earnings, as illustrated by a 30% jump in shares of Dell Technologies, which delivered a sales outlook well above consensus estimates driven by strong demand for AI-related server infrastructure.
- Both the equal-weight S&P 500 and small-cap indexes reached new highs this month, suggesting early signs of broadening market leadership as bond yields retreat.

These sources will keep you well-informed on daily market movements and longer-term investing trends!
